name: NSG F9 Auto On/Off Water Heating Rod 2500W | Smart Sensor, Waterproof, Shockproof, Fast Heating
description:
The NSG F9 Auto On/Off Water Heating Rod 2500W delivers fast, powerful, and safe water heating with intelligent sensor technology. It automatically switches on when placed in water and turns off when removed, ensuring maximum safety. Built with a waterproof and shockproof stainless-steel body, it heats water efficiently—perfect for home, hostel, and workplace everyday use.Key Features:
 2500W high-power rod for rapid heating
 Smart auto ON/OFF sensor for added safety
 Waterproof and shockproof construction
 Stainless-steel element for long life
 Energy-efficient heating performance
 Ideal for buckets, tubs, and daily useHow to Use:
1⃣ Immerse rod fully in water before plugging in
2⃣ Ensure rod does not touch bucket walls
3⃣ Allow auto sensor to control ON/OFF function
4⃣ Unplug before removing from water
5⃣ Dry and store safely after useSafety Information:
 Do not touch water while the rod is powered
 Never plug in before immersion
 Keep away from children
 Use only in a plastic bucket
 Unplug before removing the heater
